title: M8: a /loop session between fires reads 'done Nm ago' with the your-move yellow dot
expected: A looping/scheduled state that is not 'done' and not your move, with the time since the last fire (and the next fire, when known).
actual: 'ember · done 4m ago' (01:52Z) and 'ember · done 10m ago' (01:58:43Z), both with a yellow dot. Nothing says it is a loop.
truth: registry idle with exactly one live cron job (fleet loop check OK). Fires at 01:48:21Z, 01:53:07Z and 01:57:52Z.

title: T1: turns shorter than the 3 s refresh are never shown. 2 of 3 /loop fires were invisible, with no done signal.
repro: Keep Home open while ember's loop fires (2.2 s turns).
Watch ember's row and Net's bubble.
expected: Each turn shows (running → done), or at least the done age resets and the finish is announced.
actual: The fires at 01:53:06.8–01:53:09.0Z and 01:57:52.3–01:57:54.6Z were never shown. The row kept 'done 5m ago' / 'done 9m ago', with no bubble or sound.

why: ember with a live /loop (fleet: registry idle, liveJobs 1, cron */5, next fire 02:59:56Z) read 'ember · done just now' -> 'done 5m ago' -> 'done 6m ago' from 02:55:14Z to 03:01:04Z with the same #ffcf3f yellow dot as needs-you rows; nothing marks it as a loop or shows the next fire. No loop/cron awareness exists in agents.js or main.js; because each fire refreshes the file, a loop never parks and reads 'done, your move' indefinitely.
cause: agents.js:162 (end_turn -> ready, with no awareness of a live CronCreate job)

why: ember's loop fire 02:59:56.87Z -> end_turn 02:59:58.92Z (registry busy -> idle in 2 s, load 1.21) never showed: the snapshot stayed 'ready' with since 02:55:14Z, the row kept 'ember · done 5m ago', no bubble, sound count unchanged (18). The scheduled prompt is recorded isMeta and skipped, so even the tick at ~02:59:57.2Z read 'ready'; the next tick saw 'ready' again, so no phase change and no 'is done' signal.
cause: agents.js:279 (since and transition only on an observed phase change); agents.js:154 (isMeta scheduled prompt skipped); main.js:20 (3 s tick)
